inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Look, once again we see left-wing municipal politicians undermining the rule of law and coddling lawlessness right in our own backyard. On Wednesday night, Phoenix city leaders approved a radical new plan that slaps restrictive handcuffs on ICE and other federal law enforcement agencies, barring them from properly utilizing city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports that these local officials are actively scheming to obstruct federal immigration enforcement, choosing to protect open borders over public safety, national sovereignty, and the hardworking citizens who expect their leaders to uphold basic order. It’s an absolute disgrace that puts progressive ideology ahead of the safety of our communities.
